subject: Air-gapped implementation — proposed time windows & prework checklist
messages:
From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@cypherbio.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: sasha@cypherbio.com
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Air-gapped deployment — initial timeline ask

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the overview this week. CypherBio is ready to move from evaluation to an air-gapped Private deployment for our inference workloads. Before we lock a calendar invite, could you share suggested two-hour windows next week for a technical implementation session focused on: VPC boundary design, data ingress options (physical media vs approved transfer appliance), and on-prem networking preflight?

We'd like the following on the call: myself (Michael), Sasha (infrastructure lead), and our security engineer (ops@cypherbio.com). If helpful, Sasha can attach our high-level network diagram.

Goal: pick a slot where both engineering and security can align on the checklist and any blocked items so we can issue an internal change ticket.

Thanks,
Michael Chen
Head of Platform
CypherBio

(attachment: cypher-infra-outline.pdf)
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@cypherbio.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment — initial timeline ask

Michael — thanks, this is perfect.

We can do a two-hour implementation session next week. Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 2028-06-06 09:00–11:00
- Wed 2028-06-07 13:00–15:00
- Thu 2028-06-08 15:00–17:00

Quick asks to make the session productive:
- Please confirm which window you prefer and if Sasha or ops@cypherbio.com will be the primary technical POC.
- Can you share the network diagram before EOD Monday so our infra team can annotate? Drive link or PDF is fine.
- If you have constraints on bringing in physical media (custom HSMs, fenced lab), flag them now so we bring correct survival/transfer guidance.

I'll include Karthik (inference infra lead) and Monica (deploy ops) on the invite. We have a short Redwood preflight checklist that we'll attach — it covers DNS, routing, firewall rules, and allowed transfer patterns for air-gapped installs.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-airgap-checklist.pdf)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Michael Chen <michael.chen@cypherbio.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment — initial timeline ask

Adding a few technical notes from our side before the call — please see below.

- For physical-media ingestion we usually advise an encrypted transfer appliance and a staged verification VM inside the air-gapped network. If CypherBio's policies disallow appliances, we will walk through a sealed transfer process (checksum + HSM signing).
- We'll need a short inventory of on-prem hardware (GPU models, NIC details) to confirm compatibility with our quantized runtime.
- If there will be an internal jump-host, please provide the expected bastion IP ranges and the firewall ACLs we should expect.

I've attached an editable preflight template that we'll use to capture the items during the session. If you can pre-populate the hardware rows it will save time.

Karthik Iyer
Lead, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
(attachment: airgap-preflight-template.xlsx)
From: ops@cypherbio.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@cypherbio.com>, sasha@cypherbio.com
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment — initial timeline ask

Thanks — we've confirmed folks on our side. Sasha will be joining as infrastructure lead. I'm dropping a short Doodle poll for windows but our preference is Thu or Fri afternoons PT.

Poll: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234

Two clarifications:
1) We currently allow sealed USB transfer via approved courier; we need guidance on whether Redwood requires an HSM-signed blob or if checksums are sufficient for the first ingest.
2) Our security team prefers an on-site preflight checklist two business days before the implementation window for sign-off. Please confirm you can provide the checklist by Tuesday morning.

attaching: cypher-infra-outline.pdf

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've all reviewed the poll and confirmed availability. To close the loop:

Selected slot: Monday 2028-06-12 14:00–16:00 PT (2 hours) — I've sent a calendar invite to the attendees.

Planned agenda (30/90):
- 14:00–14:30: Architecture walkthrough (CypherBio network + proposed VPC boundary) — Sasha + Michael
- 14:30–15:15: Transfer options & security (sealed media vs transfer appliance) — Karthik + Cypher security
- 15:15–15:45: Runtime compatibility & hardware mapping — Redwood infra
- 15:45–16:00: Action items, sign-off preflight timing, next steps

Prework (requested before 2028-06-10 EOD):
- Updated network diagram (PDF or Drive link)
- Hardware inventory: GPU model, driver versions, NIC count
- Any documented transfer restrictions or courier contact info

Deliverables we'll provide by Tuesday morning (2028-06-06):
- Completed Redwood preflight checklist (redwood-airgap-checklist.pdf)
- Annotated preflight template with the items we expect you to fill (airgap-preflight-template.xlsx)
- A short runbook for sealed-transfer verification steps

If that all looks good I'll lock the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Dylan Brooks
